missing.what_was_said: Narayen said he would work with Frank Calderoni and the Board over the coming months to identify his successor and ensure a smooth transition. Until then, he would continue as CEO and subsequently remain Board Chair to support his successor.
Beyond saying the search was progressing well, Narayen said the goal was to have Adobe's next CEO in place to put their stamp on planning for fiscal 2027 and beyond.

Chakravarthy said he had until December 1 to work closely with Narayen on the transition. Narayen also committed to supporting a smooth transition as Executive Chair, confirming that appointment was complete but the handover remained prospective.
